name: PJM Interconnection

DOM.source: PJM 2026/2027 BRA Report (July 2025): DOM cleared at $329.17/MW-day (RTO-wide cap). $329.17 x 365 / 1,000,000 = $0.12015M/MW-yr, rounded to 0.120 — the value the Virginia notebook has used since v1.0 (kept so Virginia results are unchanged).
DOM.notes: Includes generation capacity; transmission capacity is not separately priced in RPM.

bra_sources.2027/2028: PJM 2028/2029 BRA Report (14 Jul 2026), price comparison table: RTO cleared at the $333.44 cap in 2027/28
bra_sources.2028/2029: PJM 2028/2029 BRA Report (14 Jul 2026): DOM zone $325.00/MW-day (cap)

PEPCO.capacity_cost_growth_note: Zone override of the market-wide 5%/yr: capacity price held flat in real terms (grows at the model's INFLATION_RATE, 2.5%/yr nominal). PEPCO-zone load is flat and the RELIEF Act assigns PJM data-centre capacity costs to data centres; 5%/yr compounds the 2027/28 price to ~$1,070/MW-day nominal by 2050, above PJM's uncapped 2028/29 simulation ($554.72). 5%/yr is run as a sensitivity in the Maryland notebook.
PEPCO.source: PJM 2027/2028 BRA: PEPCO zone cleared at the RTO-wide cap of $333.44/MW-day (no zonal separation). $333.44 x 365 / 1,000,000 = $0.12171M/MW-yr. Anchor chosen as the most recent capped price before the 2028/29 step-down; the 2026/27 price ($329.17 -> 0.1201) would be the strict 2026 anchor.
PEPCO.notes: PEPCO zone includes Pepco DC and Pepco MD load; zonal results do not separate Maryland. Price cap and floor applied in the 2026/27, 2027/28 and 2028/29 BRAs. _VERIFY: secondary sources report the cap/floor extended through the 2029/30 BRA; not stated in the PJM 2028/29 report itself.

bra_sources.2023/2024 to 2026/2027: MD PSC Ten-Year Plan (2025-2034) of Electric Companies in Maryland, Dec 2025, Table 14 (PJM BRA capacity prices by zone)
bra_sources.2027/2028: PJM 2028/2029 BRA Report (14 Jul 2026), price comparison table
bra_sources.2028/2029: PJM 2028/2029 BRA Report (14 Jul 2026): PEPCO zone $325.00/MW-day (cap); uncapped simulation $554.72/MW-day

notes: 5%/yr real growth: the assumption the Virginia notebook has used since v1.0, reflecting data-centre load tightening PJM reserve margins (2028/29 BRA cleared 6.8 GW short of the reliability requirement; uncapped price $554.72/MW-day). Market-wide default; a zone can override it with 'capacity_cost_growth' (number or 'INFLATION_RATE'). DOM uses the market-wide value; PEPCO overrides to INFLATION_RATE.
